pattern.description: About ten cropped user tweets hard-cut every 2-3 frames over roughly one second and settle on one tweet; the same sequence repeats from e022 and e023.
pattern.why_premium: Runs under 'half million active developers' so the stream of real testimonials visualises scale; locked camera, dark theme and tight crops keep the strobe cut rate cohesive.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline of N tweet layers: tl.set(layers[i], {autoAlpha: 1}, i * 0.083).set(layers[i - 1], {autoAlpha: 0}, i * 0.083), no tween easing (step cuts); last tweet holds; repeat the timeline for each beat.
build_hint.remotion: <Series> of <Series.Sequence durationInFrames={2}> tweet frames at 24 fps (some 3 frames), final Sequence holds; wrap in a <Loop> if reused per beat.

notes: Third occurrence of the identical tweet montage (e022, e023, e024) about 1.5 s apart, each ending on the same tweet; may be a deliberate repeated loop or a detection artefact. Camera move none here, unlike e022/e023.
